title: EVERYONE VANISHED EXCEPT YOU! 🌍😱 (What Would You Do?) #Shorts
description:
At 2:14 PM, eight billion people vanished in a single blink! 🌍💀
For one week, Pip lived like a king in empty mansions with free supercars... until the power grid died and silence drove him completely insane.

Then on Day 365, three heavy knocks echoed on his steel door:
KNOCK. KNOCK. KNOCK. 🚪

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
👉 Option A: "OPEN THE DOOR!"
👉 Option B: "BARRICADE IT AND HIDE!"

Drop your choice in the comments below! 👇
